faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate posts at IIM Lucknow is August 31, 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications via email well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate position in the IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026. This opportunity is for eligible candidates seeking a contractual government job in Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate posts is Email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate at IIM Lucknow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate position at IIM Lucknow will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month, plus HRA. This is a competitive salary for a contractual role.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. or Master's degree in Management (preferably Operations & Supply Chain Management) or a related field with First Class throughout. At least one peer-reviewed publication is also required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate position at IIM Lucknow involves two main stages: scrutiny of applications, followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the job be located?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate position will be Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, specifically at the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate position at IIM Lucknow is contractual. This offers an opportunity to work with a prestigious institution on a project basis.
